newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures hold gains late.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures hold gains late.

text.p: June 11 - U.S. stock index futures held moderate gains late. June S&P 500s sprinted up to new day's peak at 871.80 after T-bond futures closed firmer and traders got long. The contract hit small buystops above previous day high at 871.50 but lacked followthrough, and values edged off. Some noted signs of small arb sell programs as well when premium shrank.
